question: What was Greenbrier's total revenue and diluted EPS for its fiscal fourth quarter 2026 (the quarter ended August 31, 2026)?
grading: Must state that fiscal Q4 2026 (ended Aug 31, 2026) results have not been reported as of 2026-10-03 (no earnings release, 10-K or Item 2.02 8-K filed; the last results are fiscal Q3 2026, ended May 31, 2026) and give no Q4 revenue or EPS as fact. answer: Not available: Greenbrier's fiscal Q4 2026 ended August 31, 2026, but as of October 3, 2026 the company had not reported results, and there is no Q4 earnings release, fiscal 2026 Form 10-K or Item 2.02 8-K on EDGAR after the Q3 filings of July 1, 2026 [H14-E4]. The latest reported quarter is fiscal Q3 2026 (ended May 31, 2026): revenue USD 576.5 million and diluted EPS USD 0.60 [H14-E1]. The only post-quarter disclosure is the September 22, 2026 8-K announcing fiscal Q4 orders for 3,400 railcars valued at about USD 600 million, which is order flow, not revenue or earnings [H14-E3]. Guidance for the full year (revenue USD 2.4-2.5 billion; EPS USD 3.00-3.15) is not a Q4 result [H14-E1]. Last year's Q4 and full-year results came on October 28, 2025, so FY2026 results are expected in late October [H14-E5].
